scope: Development replay on four previously graded UAE drives. The earlier independent source-new study was frozen before diagnosing these errors. Its 0/3 correct natural positive answers and 2/3 passenger interior marks remain intact. This repeat does not independently estimate accuracy on another drive.

method.pink_wall: Require a separately source-verified OPEN point in both wide and close 8B views, original same-frame object tracks, connected parking and two optically confirmed parking dividers physically spanning the point’s row. Choose a point near the centre between those measured dividers. A wall must be independently segmented above it. The image has pale warm wall pixels, and cannot reliably distinguish pink from peach.
method.near_vehicle: The local 8B recognized the red SUV. Its only archived open ground point was outside the referenced marked row, so it supplies no target geometry. Current vehicle pixels and tracks uniquely corroborate the requested body colour. At least three actual repeated parking lines, a visible open aisle, an unoccupied accessible parking interior, and the point appearing on the camera side of the same vehicle establish a separate point option.
method.extent: Both are passenger-selectable interior points. The system does not certify a full bay, vehicle manoeuvre, legality or physical clearance.

remaining.F03: The gravel/hedge request has no source-verified open option and the signed surface classified the reference interior as sidewalk. No alternative parking point is claimed for that drive.
remaining.F02: The coned work area is a genuine prohibited-target control. It should never produce a selectable spot.

cross_photo_controls.scope: Both location descriptions were repeated against six different, previously opened UAE drives. These check whether the location is being reused across photos; they do not establish overall vision accuracy.

source_only_generic_check.scope: The same neutral request for a marked parking space was tried once per side on ten previously opened local source images. This covers the new fallback alone. Earlier installed parking routes may provide additional options and these twenty generic queries have no independent completeness grade.

regression_suite.scope: Marked-row references, painted-row interiors, explicit/divider choices, earlier curb alternatives, local image sources and preserved whole-bay and native-destination checks.
